source_policy.isnad: All transmitters except the earliest speaker were omitted (PDF 5, item b). Do not infer missing chains.
source_policy.honorifics: Blessings for the Prophet and Companions were omitted by the translators (PDF 5, item c). Do not insert them into source text.
source_policy.variants: Wording differences were sometimes simplified or supplemented at translator discretion (PDF 5, item d).
source_policy.chapter_titles: Minor titles were later additions and may be simplified (PDF 6, item e).
source_policy.paraphrase_and_explanation: Dialogues are not invariably literal translations and contextual explanation can be added (PDF 6, item f).
source_policy.omitted_introduction: Original text introductory hadith scholarship/discussions were omitted; the translation begins with 信仰の書 (PDF 5).

scope.source_claim: Japanese translation described as three volumes in front matter; the supplied PDF body contains only volume 1 page-range labels.
scope.volume_one_completeness_note: No physical print or full publisher source was compared. Page labels have overlap, gap and order anomalies; presence of all volume 1 narrations is not certified.
scope.numbering_note: Section citations are print page ranges. No printed narration-number structure was found in metadata/layout inspection. Generated occurrence IDs are not canonical Muslim numbers.
scope.arabic_originals: Complete Arabic narration originals are not supplied. A few Arabic terms and verse fragments occur within Japanese text/notes.
